author: PeiZhuLai
body:
#### PR description:

Backport of #52268 to 14_0_X. It adds `MCZllMesonPhotonFilter`, a HepMC-based
generator filter for Drell-Yan samples, with the same code as in master.
No existing code is changed.

#### PR validation:

Built in CMSSW_14_0_25. 20000 Pythia8 Z+jet  ee/ events were filtered in the same job with
this module and with the private version used for our current samples, modified to
use the same fixed cluster axis: both keep the same events (2455 pass both, 0 pass only
one of them).

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backport of #52268. HIG needs the filter in the RunIII2024Summer24 campaign, for the
central production of the DY background samples of the HZ analysis.
title: [14_0_X] Add MCZllMesonPhotonFilter to GeneratorInterface/GenFilters
